level.description: The caller's own level on the node

restricted.description: The node or a folder above it is restricted. Always false under me/

sizeBytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of a file's current version; null for a folder, a skill and a version written before sizes were stored

original.description: The newest original of a file (its uploaded bytes); null when it has none

sensitivity.description: A label. It changes no access

version.description: The file version the bytes were uploaded with. Lower than the file's version when its text changed afterwards

currentVersion.description: On 409: the version the file is at

kind.description: On 429 too_many_requests: the limit the key is over

limit.description: On 429 too_many_requests: calls of that kind allowed a minute. On 413 file_too_large from PUT files/original: the largest size in bytes that reason allows

retryAfterSeconds.description: On 429 too_many_requests: seconds to wait, as in Retry-After

sizeBytes.description: On 413 file_too_large and source_too_large: the size of the body in UTF-8 bytes

maxBytes.description: On 413 file_too_large and source_too_large: the largest body this server stores

reason.description: On 403 key_paused: why the key is paused (large_deletions). On 403 forbidden from an accept or a dismiss: own_proposal, the caller asked for this review; not_reviewer, the folder has reviewers and the caller is not one. On 409 conflict from a restore: path_taken, a live node holds the path; name_taken, a live skill holds the name. On 409 conflict from PUT reviewers: cannot_write, that reviewer cannot write there. On 400 invalid_request from PUT files/original: unsupported_type, type_mismatch, macro, in_skill. On 413 file_too_large from PUT files/original: original, the bytes are over ORIGINAL_MAX_BYTES; quota, the workspace's originals are full; storage_full, the server's disk is near full. On 403 not_invited: email_unverified, the identity provider has not verified the email the caller signed in with, so no membership was claimed

pausedAt.description: On 403 key_paused: when the key was paused

access.description: On 403 and 404: why access was refused, and what would help

to.description: The new path. A new name in the same folder is a rename

id.description: Restore takes it: the path may be taken again

path.description: The path it had and gets back

purgeAt.description: deletedAt plus 30 days: gone for good from then on

count.description: Nodes in the batch, itself included

id.description: A deleted node's id, from GET deleted

description.description: Decrypted here only, never in a listing

reviewEvery.description: The cadence that applies: the node's own or the nearest folder's above; from is that node's path. Null when it comes from a folder the caller cannot see; Mark reviewed still moves reviewBy by its days

truncated.description: true when there was more than the reply holds: ask for a folder to see more

parent.description: The id of the node that holds it; null for the node the picture starts at

memories.description: Memories the caller can read that cite it

kind.description: contains: a folder or skill and what is in it, weight 1. related: two nodes the same memories cite, weight the number of memories they share

original.description: The original this version reads from: the newest one at or before it; null when there is none

askedBy.description: The person who asked for this review (putFile with propose, publishSkill with mode ask); null for every other proposal

reviewers.description: The people who may accept it, with a workspace admin: the reviewers of the folder reviewersFrom names, a group as its members. Empty: see reviewersFrom

reviewersFrom.description: The folder whose reviewers apply: the nearest at or above the file that has any. Null: none, so any writer may accept. Set with reviewers empty (a group nobody is in): only a workspace admin may

private.description: Still private to its owner, the caller: only they see it, and they may always accept it (which shares it) or dismiss it, whoever the reviewers are and whether or not they may write the file

baseVersion.description: 0 to create; else the version the edit was based on

changeKind.description: Set by an import, and recorded on the version. Otherwise 'create' or 'edit'

propose.description: true: the write waits as a pending improvement, as an agent write in a review folder does

baseVersion.description: 0 to create; else the version the upload was based on

body.description: The text of the file, as the client read it from the bytes. putOriginal checks FILE_MAX_BYTES

file.description: The bytes of a PDF, a Word or Excel file or a board, at most ORIGINAL_MAX_BYTES (15,000,000 by default; 413 file_too_large over it). The type is read from the bytes

changed.description: Paths changed since the release before
Paths changed since the release before

visibility.description: Private to the caller, never the workspace's capture folder. Not with folder. A workspace agent has no private sources

content.description: The text, at most SOURCE_MAX_BYTES bytes as UTF-8 (8,000,000 by default; 413 source_too_large over it)

organizations.description: The organizations the principal belongs to

timezone.description: An IANA zone name; null clears it

joined.description: false until the person first signs in

pausedAt.description: Set while the key is paused: it still reads and searches, and every write answers 403 key_paused

principal.description: A member's email or an agent's name

level.description: null unless the caller manages the path

reasons.description: Why they can read it; null unless the caller manages the path

canWrite.description: false: they lost edit on the folder and cannot accept until they have it again

reason.description: When broken: chain, the hash chain breaks at seq; anchor, the event at seq is missing or differs from its daily anchor

anchors.description: null when the server has no anchor file: only the chain was checked

checked.description: Anchor lines compared, the newest 400 at most

lastAt.description: When that seq was last anchored

role.description: The caller's own role; null for a workspace-owned agent

captureFolder.description: Where a captured session lands when it names no folder: a shared folder path, not under me/. It need not exist yet. null clears it.

allowedEndpoints.description: The endpoints this server's operator allows for remote. Choosing one sends it the text of every chunk in the workspace, private files and memories included, and every search query

endpoint.description: A name from this server's list; null is the server's default chain

hasKey.description: Whether the workspace brought its own key. The key itself never comes back

endpoints.description: The model endpoints this server's operator lists. Choosing one sends it the text of the sessions and files the loop reads, private ones included

key.description: Write only. A string sets it, null clears it, absent keeps it for the same endpoint only

inFlightCents.description: What the batches still at the provider may cost, rounded up: counted against the cap until they close

sourcesSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD. With it, the sources created since then are queued; without it, the first pass runs

path.description: A file or a folder. Everything under a folder is locked with it

from.description: The first UTC day of the window

to.description: The last UTC day of the window, inclusive

loop.description: Improvements proposed and decided in the window

complete.description: false while older activity is still being counted: the numbers can still grow

readers.description: How many different people and agents read it

people.description: Who read it, most reads first. null unless the caller is a workspace admin

files.description: Files the caller can read, at or under the folder

pastDue.description: Their review date is before today

dueSoon.description: Their review date is within 14 days

reviewed30.description: Marked reviewed in the last 30 days

people.description: Who read it, most reads first. null unless the caller is a workspace admin

captureFolder.description: The folder a session this caller sends with no folder lands in; null: it stays private to the caller

sourceMaxBytes.description: The largest session or upload this server stores, in UTF-8 bytes (SOURCE_MAX_BYTES)

transcription.description: Whether this server hands out transcription tokens (DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is set)

listenUrl.description: Deepgram's prerecorded listen address with this server's query parameters
